resource.name: Candle
resource.low: Your candle is burning down to a stub, and the shadows lean closer.
resource.spent: Your candle gutters out. Wumbleby goes still and dark: nobody answers, nothing stirs, until you come back with a fresh one.

tagline: a crooked bedtime story for CodeRPG

idle: The clock runs a little fast
A lullaby hums down the hill
Something in the drain clears its throat
A shadow slips past the lamp
The crooked houses lean in to listen
